run_vs_env_script: run vs_env.py with a target architecture and command to execute in the Visual Studio environment
run_vs_env_x64: run vs_env.py with x64 as the target architecture to set up the 64-bit Visual Studio environment
run_vs_env_x86: run vs_env.py with x86 as the target architecture to set up the 32-bit Visual Studio environment
review_vs_env_script: review the vs_env.py script that sets up Visual Studio environment variables and runs a command
summarize_vs_env_script: summarize the vs_env.py script that wraps Visual Studio setup and command execution
